## Problem

What problem would this feature solve? Please describe the use case from the operator's
perspective.

## Proposed solution

Describe the behaviour you would like, including any relevant API, UI, provider, or data-model
changes.

## Alternatives considered

What alternatives or workarounds have you tried?

## Acquisition and privacy (if applicable)

For a provider or data-source request, list the highest available acquisition surface and the
surfaces you evaluated:

- [ ] Official API with documented terms
- [ ] Authenticated feed or export endpoint
- [ ] Public feed (RSS, JSON)
- [ ] User-supplied export file
- [ ] Scraping (last resort)

Explain why higher surfaces are insufficient. The request must concern the operator's own data;
Aggregato does not bypass access controls, paywalls, CAPTCHAs, or anti-bot measures.

## Additional context

Add links, examples, screenshots, or other context that may help evaluate the request.
